title: WireMessage
description: E-01 wire contract. All strings derived from a task or page require local sanitization before egress. Structural validation is not egress authorization.

SessionId.title: SessionId
SessionId.description: Opaque identifier; consumers must not infer authorization from its spelling.

TaskId.title: TaskId
TaskId.description: Opaque identifier; consumers must not infer authorization from its spelling.

DocumentId.title: DocumentId
DocumentId.description: Opaque document identity carried by the enclosing observation. Element IDs are meaningful only with this ID; navigation or SPA route changes require a new identity. Its spelling does not imply authorization.

ActionId.title: ActionId
ActionId.description: Opaque identifier; consumers must not infer authorization from its spelling.

TabId.title: TabId
TabId.description: Opaque identifier; consumers must not infer authorization from its spelling.

CropId.title: CropId
CropId.description: Opaque identifier; consumers must not infer authorization from its spelling.

ElementId.title: ElementId
ElementId.description: Document-scoped element ID: e for DOM-backed, v for vision-only. Interpret with the enclosing observation's doc_id; source provenance is recorded separately in src.

BBox.title: BBox
BBox.description: [x, y, width, height] in CSS page coordinates; crop-region boxes use crop pixels.

ElementState.title: ElementState
ElementState.description: Observed control state. Omitted flags are unknown or not applicable, not false. B-03 supplies semantic state; B-04 supplies occlusion. These flags do not authorize execution.

invalid.description: Whether the control is reported invalid by DOM or accessibility semantics.

occluded.description: Whether the visibility/occlusion check found the element covered by another element.

RedactedCrop.title: RedactedCrop
RedactedCrop.description: Only fully redacted crops are eligible. D-11/D-14 must verify decoded dimensions, coverage, masks and content; this schema cannot prove image safety.

ProtocolError.title: ProtocolError
ProtocolError.description: Errors before session creation omit session correlation fields. Include known correlation fields for established sessions.
